Quick facts

  • Pay: $65,000 to $125,000 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: New York, NY
  • Experience: 2+ years

Full job description


Description

As a Commercial Sales Agent with Comparion Insurance Agency, you'll have the flexibility of working remotely while building your own book of business. This is a highly consultative sales role focused on identifying, prospecting, and developing relationships with small business owners in your local market.

Successful agents are self-starters who enjoy networking, engaging with their communities, and creating new business opportunities through strategic outreach and relationship building.

Responsible for prospecting, generating, developing, and managing a book of small commercial insurance business. Counsels and advises prospects and policyholders on matters of protection and coverage. Is responsible for a specific volume of quality new business quoted and written within company guidelines. This role combines prospecting and new-business production with consultative sales, quoting through multiple carriers, and coordinating policy placement and renewals.

The typical starting salary is $65,000. Through a combination of base salary, bonuses, and uncapped commissions, the typical total first-year compensation range is $65,000 to $125,000.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Source and develop new small commercial accounts (typically business accounts with revenues under $10M) through prospecting, referrals, networking, and inbound leads.
  • Utilizes coverage knowledge to counsel and advise prospects and existing policyholders on matters of protection and coverage based on a needs and exposure assessment by obtaining data and relevant information concerning their business. Recommends appropriate insurance solutions (BOP, general liability, property, commercial auto, workers compensation, cyber, umbrella and surety/bonds).
  • Conducts front-line underwriting risk evaluation in accordance with established rules and guidelines. Prepares and presents quotes and proposals by obtaining/comparing quotes from multiple carriers using agency management systems, CRM and carrier panel rating platforms.
  • Meets goals for volume of quality new business and cross-sell opportunities quoted and written within company guidelines.
  • Works collaboratively with internal and agency partners to deliver a best-in-class customer experience.
  • Build relationships and trust with referring agents within the region to build COI/lead generation streams
  • Provide timely service for endorsements, cancellations, audits, and claims liaison as needed.
  • Stay current on carrier appetite, new products, underwriting guidelines, and industry trends
Qualifications
  • Familiarity with common small commercial products: BOP, general liability, property, commercial auto, workers compensation, cyber, umbrella and surety/bonds
  • Experience with networking, prospecting for new business and driving top of funnel leads from various sources
  • Experience using agency management systems, comparative raters
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Property & Casualty license (or progress toward them. You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years experience selling small commercial lines in an independent agency or carrier distribution channel
  • Proven track record of meeting production targets; demonstrated book of business or established referral sources

Licensing:

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired (P&C and Life).

About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

In 2022, Comparion Insurance Agency was created to transition former Liberty Mutual exclusive agents to an agency that delivers a unique value proposition to carriers with over 2,000 agents in approximately 180 cities in 44 states. We offer customers 50 insurance companies with product breadth including auto, home, life, pet, renters, umbrella, jewelry and much more. We use our scale to deliver a first-rate customer experience through consultative insurance experts located in their communities.

Our Leadership team has over 200 years of cumulative insurance experience. At Comparion, we have a philosophy of staying close to our customers and agents, so sales leadership is located throughout the country in our larger storefronts. Comparion is owned and backed by Liberty Mutual Group, a Fortune 100 company, founded in 1912

What Is the Opportunity?

The Sales Executive Team is dedicated to navigating and managing a high performing sales culture in person and/or virtually which contributes to the overall success of the Select business. The team executes on industry-leading sales strategies aligned with business objectives, builds effective relationships with customers, distribution partners and fellow employees, and creates tactical sales plans for profitable growth through extensive product knowledge and state of the art sales and influencing tactics. The team also uses digitally advanced strategies to move the business forward, leads the relationships with our aggregator/networking groups, and partners with the agent to imbed into higher producing revenue streams. As a Sales Executive, Select, you will manage and develop a moderately complex group of Travelers agency assignments/territories, optimize growth within defined new business, retention and profitability goals and deliver success within Travelers' framework of Corporate values. You will act as a brand ambassador to sell the Travelers value proposition to distribution partners. This position is an outside sales position where assigned distribution relationships within the geographic territory tend to be best served through an in-person sales strategy.

As of the date of this posting, Travelers anticipates that this posting will remain open until December 31, 2026.

What Will You Do?

  • Develop and implement comprehensive sales strategies to expand and manage a portfolio of business, with the objective of driving profitable growth.
  • Own assigned territory, including business development, leveraging performance metrics to create annual plans and manage territorial performance.

  • Develop knowledge of competitor products and capabilities and local market trends.
  • Utilize advanced data and analytics for sales decisions and performance measurement, leveraging extensive knowledge of Travelers' systems and platforms to support the sales process.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

Ready to make your mark? Discover our vibrant culture and explore career opportunities at www.Farmers.com/careers/corporate. Connect with us on Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok, and let's build something incredible together!

Workplace: Remote ( #LI-Remote )

Farmers believes in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and innovation, which thrives when we have the ability to work flexibly in a virtual setting as well as the opportunity to be together in person. Our hybrid work environment combines the best of both worlds with at least three (3) days in office and up to two (2) days virtual for employees who live within fifty (50) miles of a Farmers corporate office. Job Summary

This position supports the growth of life insurance sales by leveraging data to make recommendations to agents that drive premium and profit objectives for an assigned territory. The role takes ownership of sales outcomes through proactive engagement and solution-driven approaches. The position develops and implements business plans to enhance agency productivity and profitability, deepen relationships, and promote life insurance products and the companys value proposition. The position collaborates with internal teams, field leadership, and agency stakeholders to address complex or high-value challenges, implement life insurance sales initiatives, and achieve sales objectives. This position is an individual contributor and performs work independently while receiving minimal guidance and direction.

Essential Job Functions

Drives life insurance sales by consulting with agency owners to meet sales objectives across multiple product lines and on high-value and complex cases. Takes ownership of sales outcomes by managing both assisted and unassisted sales activities. Focuses on point-of-sale interactions to drive successful transactions and meet sales targets. Promotes life insurance products and company value proposition. Achieves activity targets and production goals by proactively engaging with district managers and agency owners to identify needs or opportunities and deliver tailored solutions, and continuously monitor outcomes. Follows up on implemented strategies to assess effectiveness and pivots as needed when results do not meet expectations. Develops and implements customized sales plans for assigned agency to drive sales growth and meet sales objectives, including quarterly and annual sales targets. Aligns agency-specific sales plans with broader business objectives and leverages adjacent revenue stream opportunities to drive life sales. Demonstrates strong knowledge of life insurance products and services to effectively compete in the marketplace. Independently provides recommendations on product illustrations, case designs, and sales focus. Acts as a liaison between internal teams, field leadership, and agency stakeholders on complex underwriting, commissions, customer service, licensing, and other issues. Builds and maintains relationships with elite agents through targeted consultation, training, and education on products, services, marketing campaigns, technology, and advanced sales strategies. Supports agency growth by assisting with producer recruitment and development, optimizing performance and profitability, and delivering guidance virtually or in-person. Monitors agency performance through CRM systems and other tools. Tracks sales activities, analyzes data and identifies trends or patterns, and provides actionable insights to help agencies address performance gaps and improve sales results. Measures changes in agency performance resulting from the deployment of various tailored solutions. Mentors, trains, and coaches less experienced team members or lower level life sales consultants to develop their skills and improve performance. Provides ongoing support and feedback to support professional development and enhance team capabilities. Performs other duties as assigned.

Education Requirements

High School Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelors degree preferred. Valid life insurance and FINRA 6, 63 licenses required. Other preferred designations include Financial Services Certified Professional (FSCP), Chartered Life Underwriter (CLU), Chartered Financial Consultant (ChFC).

Experience Requirements

Minimum seven years of experience in sales, account management, or agency operations, preferably within the insurance industry. Experience required in direct point of sale, life insurance wholesale, and sales leadership.

Additional Qualification

Strong verbal communication and listening skills. Demonstrated written communication skills. Ability to influence internal and/or external constituents. Demonstrated analytical skills. Possesses strong product knowledge. In-depth knowledge of life insurance products and services and in-depth understanding of company product offerings. Possesses strong technical aptitude. Proficient in Microsoft Office suite. Strong proficiency in CRM and similar systems. Able to adapt quickly to new technology. Develops and delivers effective presentations. Possesses a high degree of initiative. Instills commitment to organizational goals. Effectively coaches and delivers constructive feedback.

Physical Actions

Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. Job may include work performed at field locations. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Field work performed outdoors may include exposure to weather elements. Frequently sits or stands for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and places objects or materials weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Occasionally performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category may require regular travel between Farmers offices, alternative work locations, and/or field locations.

Workplace: Remote ( #LI-Remote )

Farmers believes in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and innovation, which thrives when we have the ability to work flexibly in a virtual setting as well as the opportunity to be together in person. Our hybrid work environment combines the best of both worlds with at least three (3) days in office and up to two (2) days virtual for employees who live within fifty (50) miles of a Farmers corporate office. Applicants beyond fifty (50) miles may still be considered.

Job Summary

This position supports the growth of life insurance sales by leveraging data to make recommendations to agents that drive premium and profit objectives for an assigned territory. The role takes ownership of sales outcomes through proactive engagement and solution-driven approaches. The position develops and implements business plans to enhance agency productivity and profitability, deepen relationships, and promote life insurance products and the companys value proposition. The position collaborates with internal teams, field leadership, and agency stakeholders to address complex or high-value challenges, implement life insurance sales initiatives, and achieve sales objectives. This position is an individual contributor and performs work independently while receiving minimal guidance and direction.

Essential Job Functions

Drives life insurance sales by consulting with agency owners to meet sales objectives across multiple product lines and on high-value and complex cases. Takes ownership of sales outcomes by managing both assisted and unassisted sales activities. Focuses on point-of-sale interactions to drive successful transactions and meet sales targets. Promotes life insurance products and company value proposition. Achieves activity targets and production goals by proactively engaging with district managers and agency owners to identify needs or opportunities and deliver tailored solutions, and continuously monitor outcomes. Follows up on implemented strategies to assess effectiveness and pivots as needed when results do not meet expectations. Develops and implements customized sales plans for assigned agency to drive sales growth and meet sales objectives, including quarterly and annual sales targets. Aligns agency-specific sales plans with broader business objectives and leverages adjacent revenue stream opportunities to drive life sales. Demonstrates strong knowledge of life insurance products and services to effectively compete in the marketplace. Independently provides recommendations on product illustrations, case designs, and sales focus. Acts as a liaison between internal teams, field leadership, and agency stakeholders on complex underwriting, commissions, customer service, licensing, and other issues. Builds and maintains relationships with elite agents through targeted consultation, training, and education on products, services, marketing campaigns, technology, and advanced sales strategies. Supports agency growth by assisting with producer recruitment and development, optimizing performance and profitability, and delivering guidance virtually or in-person. Monitors agency performance through CRM systems and other tools. Tracks sales activities, analyzes data and identifies trends or patterns, and provides actionable insights to help agencies address performance gaps and improve sales results. Measures changes in agency performance resulting from the deployment of various tailored solutions. Mentors, trains, and coaches less experienced team members or lower level life sales consultants to develop their skills and improve performance. Provides ongoing support and feedback to support professional development and enhance team capabilities. Performs other duties as assigned.

Education Requirements

High School Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelors degree preferred. Valid life insurance and FINRA 6, 63 licenses required. Other preferred designations include Financial Services Certified Professional (FSCP), Chartered Life Underwriter (CLU), Chartered Financial Consultant (ChFC).

Experience Requirements

Minimum seven years of experience in sales, account management, or agency operations, preferably within the insurance industry. Experience required in direct point of sale, life insurance wholesale, and sales leadership.

Additional Qualification

Strong verbal communication and listening skills. Demonstrated written communication skills. Ability to influence internal and/or external constituents. Demonstrated analytical skills. Possesses strong product knowledge. In-depth knowledge of life insurance products and services and in-depth understanding of company product offerings. Possesses strong technical aptitude. Proficient in Microsoft Office suite. Strong proficiency in CRM and similar systems. Able to adapt quickly to new technology. Develops and delivers effective presentations. Possesses a high degree of initiative. Instills commitment to organizational goals. Effectively coaches and delivers constructive feedback.

Physical Actions

Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. Job may include work performed at field locations. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Field work performed outdoors may include exposure to weather elements. Frequently sits or stands for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and places objects or materials weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Occasionally performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category may require regular travel between Farmers offices, alternative work locations, and/or field locations.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Sales Representative, Insurance Sales, Insurance Agent
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

The Direct Sales Agent Specialist is responsible for driving profitable growth by generating new business, cross-selling existing customers, and building lasting relationships. This role focuses on understanding customer needs, delivering tailored solutions, and maintaining a strong book of business.

This role sells to local customers both in person and over the phone, while driving growth through community involvement, relationship building, and outside marketing efforts.

If you are ready to start working in a fun & exciting environment while making adifference, then apply to join our team today!

As a Direct Sales Agent Specialist, you will:

  • Achieve sales goals through new business, cross-sell, and retention
  • Build and maintain a consistent pipeline, including local lead generation and referrals
  • Develop relationships within the community (e.g., dealerships, events, local partners) to support business growth
  • Conduct outbound prospecting and follow-ups to convert opportunities into sales
  • Partner with leadership to support sales and local marketing initiatives
  • Stay informed on products, underwriting guidelines, and market competition
  • Deliver results aligned with performance standards, compliance requirements, and customer experience expectations

What makes Direct Auto Insurance unique?

  • Day 1 Benefits
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Tuition Reimbursement, Pension & so much more
  • 20 PTO Days per year &6Paid Holidays
  • Ability to sell a multitude of industry-leading products through retail stores andphone
  • Entrepreneurial, performance-based, and results-focused culture
  • Multi-tiered and comprehensive paid training program
  • Base hourly rate plus uncapped monthly incentive

MinimumQualifications:

  • 0 2years of experience
  • P&C licensing (Preferred) or mustattainrequired licensure within90 daysof joining thecompany.

Skills

Active Learning, Adaptability, Business Integrity, Customer Service, Persuasion, Sales, Social Orientation, Time Management

Base compensation: $20.00 per hour

Total Compensation:
In addition to the base hourly rate, total compensation for this role may include incentive pay, such as commissions and bonuses, based on individual and team performance.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Sales Representative, Insurance Sales, Insurance Agent
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Allstates sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from lifes uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.

Licensed Insurance Sales Representative (Remote / Home-Based)

Allstates sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from lifes uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.


As a full-time Insurance Sales Representative, you will:

  • Engage with active insurance shoppers via inbound/outbound calls, live chat, SMS, and more in a work from home call center environment.
  • Use your insurance expertise to uncover customer needs, identify coverage gaps, and recommend tailored solutions from Allstate products and products within the Allstate family of companies.
  • Convert warm leads into customers using a proven consultative sales strategy no cold calling required.
  • Work from home to drive sales growth while delivering an exceptional, customer-first experience.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Pay: $18/hour
  • Average Total Compensation: $52,730$76,480/year (base + uncapped performance-based incentives)
  • Incentives are productivity-based and governed by the applicable bonus plan, which is subject to change at Allstates discretion.

Full suite of employee benefits starting day one, including:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match and pension plan
  • Tuition reimbursement and career development
  • Wellness programs

Additional Benefits

  • Paid training from day one (classroom and hands-on)
  • Licensing support: study materials, exam reimbursement, and assistance
  • Monthly internet reimbursement
  • Home office equipment provided by Allstate

Why Join Allstate

  • No Prospecting: Warm leads delivered directly to you
  • Career Growth: Develop your skills within a dynamic, supportive Fortune 100 company
  • Supportive Culture: Learn from best-in-class leaders and motivated teammates
  • Trusted Brand: Be part of a company with 90+ years of industry experience
  • Diverse & Reputable Product Suite: Sell from a wide portfolio that meets every customers needs

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in sales or customer service (with a sales focus)
  • Active Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license in your state of residence (preferred)
  • If unlicensed, ability to obtain a Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license with Allstates support
  • Sales Representatives are required to obtain and maintain all required resident and non-resident Producer licenses necessary to sell insurance products in any state designated by Allstate. This includes obtaining non-resident Producer licenses in all states as required for the role.
  • If hired, Sales Representative must relinquish all non-Allstate insurance carrier appointments and may not hold active appointments with other carriers while employed in this role, in accordance with Allstate licensing and appointment policies.
  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Reliable high-speed internet with wired connection (Ethernet)
  • Dedicated, distraction-free home workspace (equipment provided)
  • Comfortable working evenings and weekends
  • Receptive to feedback and performance coaching
  • Strong communication, critical thinking, and multitasking skills
  • Competitive, highly self-motivated and enjoys being rewarded for your efforts
  • Able to work independently and hold yourself accountable for your performance
  • Ability to navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously

Essential Job Functions

  • Handle inbound and outbound customer calls as the primary method of engagement
  • Maintain consistent availability during assigned work hours to meet call volume and service expectations, especially during the first 90 days of employment
  • Conduct consultative sales conversations and complete transactions during live customer interactions
  • Adhere to assigned schedules, including evenings and weekends, based on business needs
  • Meet or exceed established productivity, quality, and performance standards
  • Navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously while actively assisting customers

This position is only available within theUS, but notcurrently available for Puerto Rico, California, New York, Alaska, Hawaii, or Washington state residents.

Candidates who reside in locations where the local minimum wage exceeds the base pay for this position are also not eligible for consideration. This is due to compliance with wage regulations and internal compensation practices.

Allstate provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of their role. During the first 90 days of employment, reasonable accommodations generally do not include removing essential job functions, creating new positions, or lowering performance or productivity standards.

Full job description


Description

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, small commercial auto, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, you'll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed. No prior insurance experience required.

THIS POSITION HAS IN-OFFICE REQUIREMENTS.

This is a full-time, field-based employee position. Applicants must be able to travel within their local community to meet with customers and build relationships. Reliable transportation, such as a valid driver's license or another means of travel, is preferred.

Licensing Requirement:
Candidates are welcome to apply even if you do not currently hold your Property & Casualty and Life insurance licenses; however, you must obtain both licenses before your scheduled start date. Whether you already hold your licenses or obtain them before your start date, youll receive a $1,000 professional start bonus to support your transition into your new role!

What you'll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, small commercial auto, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

Essential functions include: meeting with customers in the office and in the community, communicating by phone, email, and in person, traveling locally, and using a computer and sales software.

Qualifications

Day One Skills & Traits:

  • Self-motivated and accountable: you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive: you follow through and do what you say you'll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy: you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused: you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Strong communicator: you're comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Comfortable with technology: you can learn and use new software and digital tools with ease.
  • Composed and dependable: you stay organized and professional while managing multiple customer needs.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

In 2022, Comparion Insurance Agency was created to transition former Liberty Mutual exclusive agents to an agency that delivers a unique value proposition to carriers with over 2,000 agents in approximately 180 cities in 44 states. We offer customers 50 insurance companies with product breadth including auto, home, life, pet, renters, umbrella, jewelry and much more. We use our scale to deliver a first-rate customer experience through consultative insurance experts located in their communities.

Our Leadership team has over 200 years of cumulative insurance experience. At Comparion, we have a philosophy of staying close to our customers and agents, so sales leadership is located throughout the country in our larger storefronts. Comparion is owned and backed by Liberty Mutual Group, a Fortune 100 company, founded in 1912

Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.

  • California
  • Los Angeles Incorporated
  • Los Angeles Unincorporated
  • Philadelphia

Description

As a Commercial Sales Agent with Comparion Insurance Agency, you'll have the flexibility of working remotely while building your own book of business. This is a highly consultative sales role focused on identifying, prospecting, and developing relationships with small business owners in your local market.

Successful agents are self-starters who enjoy networking, engaging with their communities, and creating new business opportunities through strategic outreach and relationship building.

Responsible for prospecting, generating, developing, and managing a book of small commercial insurance business. Counsels and advises prospects and policyholders on matters of protection and coverage. Is responsible for a specific volume of quality new business quoted and written within company guidelines. This role combines prospecting and new-business production with consultative sales, quoting through multiple carriers, and coordinating policy placement and renewals.

The typical starting salary is $65,000. Through a combination of base salary, bonuses, and uncapped commissions, the typical total first-year compensation range is $65,000 to $125,000.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Source and develop new small commercial accounts (typically business accounts with revenues under $10M) through prospecting, referrals, networking, and inbound leads.
  • Utilizes coverage knowledge to counsel and advise prospects and existing policyholders on matters of protection and coverage based on a needs and exposure assessment by obtaining data and relevant information concerning their business. Recommends appropriate insurance solutions (BOP, general liability, property, commercial auto, workers compensation, cyber, umbrella and surety/bonds).
  • Conducts front-line underwriting risk evaluation in accordance with established rules and guidelines. Prepares and presents quotes and proposals by obtaining/comparing quotes from multiple carriers using agency management systems, CRM and carrier panel rating platforms.
  • Meets goals for volume of quality new business and cross-sell opportunities quoted and written within company guidelines.
  • Works collaboratively with internal and agency partners to deliver a best-in-class customer experience.
  • Build relationships and trust with referring agents within the region to build COI/lead generation streams
  • Provide timely service for endorsements, cancellations, audits, and claims liaison as needed.
  • Stay current on carrier appetite, new products, underwriting guidelines, and industry trends

Qualifications

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, youll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed no prior insurance experience required.

Description

What youll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who Were Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive you follow through and do what you say youll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing youre comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy youre able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.

  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

Job.JobTitle: Sr. Sales Executive - Select Outside Sales
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $112,000 to $184,800 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: San Antonio, TX
  • Education: Bachelor's degree
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$112,000.00 - $184,800.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

The Sales Executive Team is dedicated to navigating and managing a high performing sales culture in-person and/or virtually which contributes to the overall success of the Select business. The team executes on industry-leading sales strategies aligned with business objectives, builds effective relationships with customers, distribution partners and fellow employees, and creates tactical sales plans for profitable growth through extensive product knowledge and state of the art sales and influencing tactics. The team also uses digitally advanced strategies to move the business forward, leads the relationships with our aggregator/networking groups, and partners with the agent to imbed into higher producing revenue streams. As a Senior Sales Executive, Select, you will manage and develop a complex group of Travelers agency assignments/territories as a Subject Matter Expert, optimize growth within defined new business, retention and profitability goals and deliver success within Travelers' framework of Corporate values. You will act as a brand ambassador to sell the Travelers value proposition to distribution partners. You may also be responsible for mentoring, coaching or managing less experienced members of the team. This position is an outside sales position where assigned distribution relationships within the geographic territory tend to be best served through an in-person sales strategy.

What Will You Do?

  • Develop, influence, and implement advanced sales strategies to expand and manage a high-value portfolio of business, with the objective of driving profitable growth.
  • Own assigned territory, including business development, leveraging performance metrics to create annual plans and manage territorial performance.
  • Conduct comprehensive agency diagnostics to assess performance and identify strategic growth opportunities.
  • Facilitate high-level agency appointments and build long-term relationships through office visits (both in-person and virtual).
  • Prospect, onboard and set performance goals for new agencies, while providing training and support.
  • May pre-qualify accounts as needed.
  • Influence key agency partners through exceptional communication and negotiation skills.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, such as, Product, Underwriting, and Operations to ensure alignment of sales strategies with broader business objectives.
  • Understand Travelers Enterprise focus and seize opportunities to cross-sell Travelers products by initiating cross-functional meetings. Identify book transfer opportunities.
  • Maintain extensive knowledge of competitor products and capabilities and local market trends and understands impact of state regulatory environment on agency business.
  • Responsible for facilitating workshops and actively leading point of sale presentations for both internal and external audiences.
  • Participate in and may lead team, cross team and/or cross business related projects.
  • May provide training, coaching and mentoring to Associate Sales Executives and Sales Executives or manage staff on limited basis.
  • Utilize sophisticated data and analytics to guide strategic sales decisions, measure performance metrics and identify opportunities for additional products and services to maintain a balanced portfolio.
  • Leverage thorough knowledge of Travelers' systems and platforms to support the sales process.
  • Leverage AI technologies to optimize industry processes, enhance decision-making, and drive innovation, while continuously learning and adapting to emerging AI trends and tools.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree in sales, marketing, business or related field.
  • Five or more years of insurance sales or related experience in managing a book of business, driving significant sales growth, achieving sales targets, conducting agency diagnostics and utilizing digital sales tools.
  • Certified Insurance Counselor (CIC) (or willingness to pursue).
  • Extensive knowledge of Travelers products and general Property & Casualty marketplace.
  • Extensive influencing and negotiation skills to encourage agency partners to adopt Travelers products and services.
  • Proven ability to collaboratively build and maintain relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders both internally and externally.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to define goals and priorities and meet these goals in a timely manner.
  • Exceptional organizational skills to manage complex tasks and priorities and meet sales goals and deadlines effectively.
  • Demonstrated skills in coaching, training and mentoring others.

What is a Must Have?

  • Four years of sales experience within the insurance industry.
  • Must live in the territory that they manage and have the ability to travel up to 75% of the time.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Job.JobTitle: Alternative Investment Sales Specialist Account Executive
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Account Executive, Insurance Sales, Insurance Sales Representative
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $190,000 to $480,000 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Los Angeles, CA
  • Experience: 5+ years
  • Benefits: 401(k), paid time off, tuition assistance

Full job description

Alternate Locations: Los Angeles, CA (California); Dallas, TX (Texas); Houston, TX (Texas); San Diego, CA (California); San Francisco, CA (California); Seattle, WA (Washington)

Work Arrangement:

Remote : Work at home employee residing outside of a commutable distance to an office location.

Relocation assistance: is not available for this opportunity.

Requisition #: 76875

The Role at a Glance

The Alternative Investment Sales Specialist Account Executive will develop, direct, implement, and maintain a business plan, to achieve sales and growth goals for alternative investments. They will partner closely with key stakeholders across field sales, investment, product management, and marketing in the distribution of alternative investment solutions to retail/HNW advisors and key centers of influence within the Western Region. This individual will leverage their alternative investments expertise and experience in executing critical educational and sales initiatives, aimed at driving adoption of Lincoln's alternatives solutions among wealth management advisors.

What you'll be doing

  • Develop deep understanding of Lincoln Financial's Alternatives platform and effectively represent individual solutions, to wealth management firms, advisors and clients, in partnership with Sales team.
  • Provide subject matter expertise with Alternatives and collaborate with Sales team in organizing and executing fund roadshows and other field engagement routines, with prescribed follow-up activities to drive sales results.
  • Partner with investment, product and distribution teams, along with other key stakeholders, to promote and distribute a wide range of strategies and structures for retail/HNW advisors.
  • Support the development and rationalization of a variety of different types of Alternative Investment marketing collateral and branding initiatives (e.g., presentation decks, educational materials, thought leadership/thematic content).
  • Stay abreast of industry trends, competitive landscape and investor preferences to support product development and positioning in various educational forums, conferences, and other events.
  • Develops and maintains a more complex sales plan to increase sales revenue and market share within alternative investments.
  • Increases penetration in territory of by optimizing and growing relationships in partnership with existing field wholesale team to drive sales at targeted firms.
  • Cultivates, directs, and maintains client relationships within assigned territory's firms.
  • Increases financial advisors' awareness and drives adoption of Lincoln's alternative investments products and services within their assigned territory.
  • Partners with Lincoln's wholesale team to Develop, direct, and execute a sales plan to increase/gain opportunities to introduce Lincoln's private funds management and other resources to targeted advisors within their assigned territory.
  • Develops a comprehensive understanding of existing/targeted firms/advisors including targeted market segments, how they operate, and/or value proposition(s) and is known by them.
  • Works effectively to support growth of Lincoln's alternative investment offerings to maximize and capitalize on the opportunities to cross sell and penetrate new and existing financial advisors.
  • Conducts firm/advisor meetings to achieve sales targets. (e.g. due diligence meetings, one-on-one meetings, sponsorship and speaking opportunities).
  • Identifies and communicates any potential conflicts regarding Lincoln's alternative investments
  • Adhere to LFDs Culture of Compliance. Comply with LFDs policies and procedures.

What we're looking for

Must-Haves

  • 3-5+ years experience in alternatives distribution that aligns with the specific responsibilities for this position.
  • FINRA Series 7 and 63 License
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
  • Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills, identifying the appropriate resources and tools to drive solutions.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to adapt quickly in a changing work environment

Preferred

  • MBA/CFA/CAIA
  • FINRA Series 24

Application Deadline

Applications for this position will be accepted through December 31, 2026, subject to earlier closure due to applicant volume.

What's it like to work here?

At Lincoln Financial, we love what we do. We make meaningful contributions each and every day to empower our customers to take charge of their lives. Working alongside dedicated and talented colleagues, we build fulfilling careers and stronger communities through a company that values our unique perspectives, insights and contributions and invests in programs that empower each of us to take charge of our own future.

What's in it for you:

  • Clearly defined career tracks and job levels, along with associated behaviors for each of Lincoln's core values and leadership attributes

  • Leadership development and virtual training opportunities

  • PTO/parental leave

  • Competitive 401K and employee benefits

  • Free financial counseling, health coaching and employee assistance program

  • Tuition assistance program

  • Work arrangements that work for you

  • Effective productivity/technology tools and training

The pay range for this position is $190,000 - $480,000 with anticipated pay for new hires between the minimum and midpoint of the range and could vary above and below the listed range as permitted by applicable law. Pay is based on non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, education, location, licensure requirements, proficiency and qualifications required for the role. The base pay is just one component of Lincoln's total rewards package for employees. In addition, the role may be eligible for the Annual Incentive Program, which is discretionary and based on the performance of the company, business unit and individual. Other rewards may include long-term incentives, sales incentives and Lincoln's standard benefits package.

About The Company

Lincoln Financial (NYSE: LNC) helps people to confidently plan for their version of a successful future. We focus on identifying a clear path to financial security, with products including annuities, life insurance, group protection, and retirement plan services.

With our 120-year track record of expertise and integrity, millions of customers trust our solutions and service to help put their goals in reach.

Lincoln Financial Distributors, a broker-dealer, is the wholesale distribution organization of Lincoln Financial. Lincoln Financial is the marketing name for Lincoln Financial Corporation and its affiliates including The Lincoln National Life Insurance Company, Fort Wayne, IN, and Lincoln Life & Annuity Company of New York, Syracuse, NY. Lincoln Financial affiliates, their distributors, and their respective employees, representatives and/or insurance agents do not provide tax, accounting or legal advice.

Lincoln is committed to creating an inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Follow us on Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube. For the latest company news, visit our newsroom.

Be Aware of Fraudulent Recruiting Activities

If you are interested in a career at Lincoln, we encourage you to review our current openings and apply on our website. Lincoln values the privacy and security of every applicant and urges all applicants to diligently protect their sensitive personal information from scams targeting job seekers. These scams can take many forms including fake employment applications, bogus interviews and falsified offer letters.

Lincoln will not ask applicants to provide their social security numbers, date of birth, bank account information or other sensitive information in job applications. Additionally, our recruiters do not communicate with applicants through free e-mail accounts (Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or conduct interviews utilizing video chat rooms. We will never ask applicants to provide payment during the hiring process or extend an offer without conducting a phone, live video or in-person interview. Please contact Lincoln's fraud team at fraudhotline@lfg.com if you encounter a recruiter or see a job opportunity that seems suspicious.

Additional Information

This position may be subject to Lincoln's Political Contribution Policy. An offer of employment may be contingent upon disclosing to Lincoln the details of certain political contributions. Lincoln may decline to extend an offer or terminate employment for this role if it determines political contributions made could have an adverse impact on Lincoln's current or future business interests, misrepresentations were made, or for failure to fully disclose applicable political contributions and or fundraising activities.

Any unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles submitted through our web site or to personal e-mail accounts of employees of Lincoln Financial are considered property of Lincoln Financial and are not subject to payment of agency fees.

Lincoln Financial ("Lincoln" or "the Company") is an Equal Opportunity employer and, as such, is committed in policy and practice to recruit, hire, compensate, train and promote, in all job classifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin or disability. Opportunities throughout Lincoln are available to employees and applicants are evaluated on the basis of job qualifications. If you are a person with a disability that impedes your ability to express your interest for a position through our online application process, or require TTY/TDD assistance, contact us by calling (866) 922-6543.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Customer Service Representative, Customer Service / Account Support, Policy Administration Specialist
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $75,000 to $85,000 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Phoenix, AZ
  • Experience: 3+ years
  • Benefits: 401(k), paid time off, paid holidays

Full job description

Job Description

Posting Description

Surety Account Manager, Processor Team Lead

Summary

The Surety Account Manager is responsible for managing client relationships, overseeing surety account service activities, and providing leadership and direction to the Surety Processing team. This role serves as the primary point of contact for clients, carriers, and internal stakeholders while ensuring the accurate and timely issuance, renewal, and servicing of surety bonds. The Surety Account Manager drives operational excellence through workflow management, quality control, staff development, and process improvement while delivering exceptional client service and maintaining strong carrier relationships.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, surety carriers, producers, and internal business partners.
  • Participate in client meetings and provide consultative support regarding bond programs, renewals, and service needs.
  • Lead the review of surety proposals, bond documentation, renewal information, and carrier source documents for accuracy and completeness.
  • Oversee the day-to-day operations of the Surety Processing team, including workflow distribution, prioritization, and quality assurance.
  • Provide guidance, training, and mentorship to surety processors to support performance, productivity, and professional development.
  • Monitor departmental service standards and ensure timely completion of bond issuance, renewals, endorsements, cancellations, and reinstatements.
  • Manage and maintain client records, bond schedules, policy information, and supporting documentation within agency management systems and carrier portals.
  • Review and approve bond requests, renewal processing, invoices, finance agreements, and related surety transactions.
  • Coordinate the issuance of new and renewal bonds, including bid, performance, payment, maintenance, and miscellaneous bonds.
  • Track bond renewals and ensure all required documentation and billing information is processed accurately and within established service timelines.
  • Address client service issues, billing inquiries, and bond-related concerns while collaborating with carriers and internal departments as needed.
  • Assist with process development, workflow enhancements, and operational efficiency initiatives to improve overall team performance.
  • Maintain compliance with agency procedures, carrier requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
  • Support special projects and departmental initiatives as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of surety bonds, bond administration processes, and surety industry practices.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to motivate, coach, and develop team members.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong client relationship management and customer service skills.
  • Ability to make sound independent decisions and exercise professional judgment.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with clients, carriers, producers, and internal teams.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office products, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Experience working with agency management systems and carrier platforms preferred.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities, processes, and technology.

Education and Experience

  • Associate's degree or equivalent experience required; Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • 3+ years of insurance industry experience, including surety account management, surety operations, or related client service experience.
  • Previous leadership, supervisory, or team lead experience preferred.
  • Experience managing bond issuance, renewals, and surety servicing activities preferred.

Certificates, Licenses, and Registration

  • Property & Casualty Insurance License required or obtainable within 30 days of hire.
  • Surety-specific industry designations or advanced insurance certifications are a plus.

What we Offer:

We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $75,000.00 – $85,000.00. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.

NFP and You... Better Together!

NFP is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

#LI-NG1

2587820

Job Description

Are you looking to be a member of an industry-leading team? Do you want to deliver innovative and effective solutions to clients? If you said yes, then apply to join our Commercial Risk team in Dallas!

This role is hybrid out of our office in Dallas, TX.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Retains and grows Aon's business, cultivating relationships with senior-most client decision-makers in the client organization as well as with day-to-day client contacts.
  • Drives the renewal process, assembling the appropriate team to develop and implement the client-specific renewal strategy.
  • Coordinates with Brokers in the development and delivery of renewal strategies.
  • Facilitates critical relationships between clients, Aon and insurers.
  • Ensures client service team understanding of client needs, service delivery methods, and the economic framework relevant to services delivered.
  • Leads stewardship planning and delivery
  • Ensures overall account profitability with a value-based approach for the scope of service and costs associated with client service.
  • Negotiates Aon compensation for services, whether fee or commission-based, accordingly.
  • Educates clients in risk management, risk transfer, market issues and relevant trends including appropriate benchmarking.
  • Arranges appropriate Aon resources to support clients in unusual circumstances such as large claims, etc.
  • Involves others across geographic (including international), functional and business unit boundaries to define interdependent responses to opportunities to grow the business.
  • Manages input to and follow-up on invoicing and receivables process for assigned clients, ensuring timely collections.

How this opportunity is different:

We are looking for a leader who is responsible for the day-to-day, account management of Aon's relationships with assigned clients as their primary role. You will lead client service teams to identify and meet client needs and thereby retain and grow a profitable book of business. Through service, pricing, consultation and reporting, you will promote the value Aon delivers to clients.

Experience:

  • 5+ years of appropriate insurance experience. Insurance licensing as required.

  • Experience within Real Estate, Digital Infrastructure, or related industries is highly valued.

  • Strong basic knowledge of the insurance business and the assigned clients' needs, as well as all major lines of business.
  • Organizational, interpersonal, and project management skills with an ability to multi-task and prioritize workload with attention to detail.
  • Critical thinking skills with the ability to clearly express thoughts and concepts at various levels.
  • Excellent digital literacy, including working experience with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook).
  • Solid negotiation skills.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree, or the equivalent.
  • Insurance licensing as required.

Compensation:

The salary range for this position is $150,000 - $200,000 annually. This salary range is an estimate and the actual salary will vary based on applicant's education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant's geographic location.

This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon's annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus and production incentives in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus and production incentives varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan.

How we support our colleagues

Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon's discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies.

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions for our colleagues as well.

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

Aon values an innovative and inclusive workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Aon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

Quick facts

Full job description

Company Details

Intrepid Direct Insurance (IDI) is a rapidly growing direct to consumer property and casualty insurance company. A member of the W. R. Berkley Corporation, a fortune 500 company, rated A+ (Superior) by A.M. Best, Intrepid Direct's vision is to make life better for business. The insurance industry has not evolved with innovation like other major industries. We're here to change that. We are making life better for our customers, shareholders, and our team members by leveraging data and technology as insurance experts for our targeted customers. You will be part of a highly collaborative team of talented and focused professionals. Join a group that enjoys working together, trusts each other, and takes pride in our hard-earned success.

https://intrepiddirect.com/

The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer.

Responsibilities

The Chief Customer and Revenue Officer (CCRO) is a senior executive with enterprise accountability for revenue growth, customer acquisition, retention, and market execution across Agency, Sales, and Marketing. The CCRO leads through experienced functional leaders across Agency, Sales, and Marketing, setting strategy, creating alignment, and holding leaders accountable for coordinated execution and profitable growth and is responsible for building a durable, profitable growth engine aligned with Intrepid Direct's underwriting appetite, customer promise, and strategic priorities.

This executive will work in close partnership with the President and will increasingly represent the company in high-value customer and partner relationships. The CCRO is expected to personally visit, develop, negotiate with, and help close large and strategically important customers, expanding executive-level commercial leadership capacity while maintaining close alignment with the President on material opportunities.

As a key member of the senior leadership team, the CCRO will help shape enterprise strategy, identify future verticals and partnerships, and translate market opportunities into disciplined execution, sustained revenue growth, strong retention, and profitable portfolio performance.

Key functions include but are not limited to:

Enterprise Revenue Ownership & Go-to-Market Strategy

  • Own enterprise revenue strategy and results across Agency, Sales, and Marketing, including new business production, customer retention, revenue quality, and profitable growth.
  • Define and execute an integrated go-to-market strategy for targeted franchise brands, verticals, geographies, national accounts, and strategic partnerships.
  • Partner with underwriting, actuarial, product, and finance leaders to align growth objectives with risk appetite, pricing discipline, portfolio performance, and return on acquisition investment.
  • Lead segmentation, targeting, pipeline, retention, and account-development strategies that create a predictable, high-quality book of business.
  • Use market, customer, competitor, and performance insights to inform enterprise priorities and resource allocation.
  • Work closely with the President to evaluate and launch future verticals, franchisor relationships, and strategic partnerships, with clear ownership and seamless handoffs into production and service.

Strategic Customer Leadership & Executive Market Presence

  • Serve as the senior executive sponsor for the company's largest, most complex, and most strategically important customers and partners.
  • Personally lead or support customer visits, executive presentations, negotiations, relationship development, and closing strategies for large accounts.
  • Assume primary executive responsibility for many strategic customer and partner interactions currently led by the President, while maintaining close communication and alignment with the President.
  • Build trusted, long-term relationships with franchise systems, large operators, associations, vendors, and other market partners.
  • Represent Intrepid Direct at customer meetings, industry events, conferences, and other external forums.
  • Travel approximately 20% based on business needs, primarily for strategic customer, partner, and market-development activity.

Agency & Client Success Leadership

  • Provide executive oversight of the Agency and client success organization through its functional leader, ensuring the function is aligned with Intrepid Direct's revenue strategy, retention priorities, service standards, and customer experience expectations.
  • Partner with the Agency leader to establish service standards, operating disciplines, governance, and performance measures that deliver a responsive, consultative, and best-in-class customer experience.
  • Ensure the Agency is positioned as a strategic revenue and retention function, not solely a service operation.
  • Align Agency, Sales, Marketing, Underwriting, Claims, and Operations around customer needs, franchise requirements, service trends, renewal strategy, and profitability drivers.
  • Sponsor scalable process improvements and talent capability planning within Agency that support growth without sacrificing service quality or customer intimacy.

Sales Leadership

  • Serve as the primary executive leader for the sales strategy and operating model, including prospect data acquisition, territory and vertical planning, pipeline discipline, forecasting, production expectations, strategic account development, and executive-level deal support.
  • Provide executive oversight of the sales organization and hold leaders and team members accountable for production, pipeline quality, conversion, strategic account development, and growth results.
  • Maintain active involvement in high-value opportunities, complex deals, and material account negotiations.
  • Build a disciplined sales culture focused on preparation, customer insight, consultative selling, accountability, and profitable growth.

Marketing & Brand Leadership

  • Provide executive oversight of Marketing, empowering the Marketing leader to execute brand, campaign, content, event, and demand-generation strategies while holding the function accountable for measurable commercial outcomes.
  • Set enterprise commercial direction for positioning, customer acquisition priorities, market experiments, and growth campaigns, in partnership with the Marketing leader.
  • Ensure consistent and differentiated expression of the Intrepid Direct brand and value proposition across every customer touchpoint.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and analytics to evaluate marketing effectiveness and improve return on investment.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate closely with the President and with underwriting, claims, operations, technology/data, actuarial, and finance leaders to align customer, risk, process, and enablement priorities.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve revenue growth, retention, operating efficiency, customer experience, and market responsiveness.
  • Create clear governance, decision rights, and handoffs across revenue-generating and customer-serving functions.
  • Establish a consistent revenue operating cadence that provides the President and senior leadership team with transparent visibility into pipeline, retention, revenue quality, marketing effectiveness, customer opportunities, market conditions, and cross-functional execution risks.

Team Leadership & Organizational Capability

  • Lead a high-performing team of functional leaders across Agency, Sales, and Marketing, creating shared priorities, clear accountabilities, and coordinated execution across the revenue organization.
  • Evaluate and evolve the organizational structure, leadership roles, capabilities, and talent required to support Intrepid Direct's growth strategy.
  • Set measurable goals, KPIs, performance standards, and accountability mechanisms across all revenue functions.
  • Coach and develop functional leaders, ensuring they have the clarity, resources, decision rights, accountability, succession plans, and talent pipelines needed to lead effectively and support continued growth.
  • Develop a strong working knowledge of the CRM and related revenue technology to improve visibility, execution, and coordination across departments

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, risk management, insurance, or a related field required.
  • Advanced degree preferred.
  • Relevant insurance or industry designations preferred
  • 15+ years of progressively responsible leadership experience in commercial insurance, including significant experience in sales, distribution, agency operations, underwriting, marketing, or customer strategy; 20+ years preferred.
  • Demonstrated success owning a broad revenue agenda and delivering sustained, profitable growth across multiple customer-facing functions.
  • Experience leading through experienced functional managers, integrating Agency, Sales, and Marketing into a coordinated commercial organization, and creating accountability while enabling leaders to execute within their areas of expertise.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop executive relationships, visit and advise large customers, lead complex negotiations, and close strategic accounts or partnerships.
  • Strong knowledge of commercial property and casualty products, underwriting dynamics, direct and intermediary distribution models, customer lifecycle management, and service operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into execution, establish accountability, use data to support decisions, and build scalable processes.
  • Executive presence, sound judgment, high personal accountability, and the ability to serve as a trusted partner to the President and senior leadership team.
  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 20% based on business needs.

Additional Company Details
